item.title: Version 3.3.0
item.description:
• PrayerTimes Pro is three things now — the living sky behind your countdown, every adhan reciter, and your streaks and qada. In the same pass the Siri "Next Prayer" shortcut, the adhan's volume and the pre-prayer announcement timings became free for everyone. Nothing you were already using has been taken away
  • The direct download stands alongside the Mac App Store again — the same app at the same price on either, so the channel is yours to pick
  • Bring your own muezzin — use a recording you already love, give each prayer its own reciter, and trim it to begin exactly where you want
  • A prayer-times widget for your desktop and Notification Centre
  • Your prayer log follows you between Macs through your own iCloud, with an export, a year in review, and an ambient clock for a second screen. Your preferences follow you too; what belongs to one machine stays on it
  • A desert that moves with the day behind the countdown — seven hours of light, drawn for this release — or your own photograph there instead
  • See how often you prayed on time, alongside the streak calendar and the qada ledger
  • Today's Prayer Times is available to Shortcuts, so you can build a morning routine around it
  • Alerts, spoken announcements and the adhan each keep the sound you chose for them, and quiet hours are one dial
  • A call-to-prayer recording that arrives damaged is discarded rather than kept, and a bundled adhan plays in its place
  • Your licence key no longer lingers in your clipboard history after you copy it

item.title: Version 4.1.0
item.description:
• Hero Size. Three hand-laid tiers of the Home hero — large, medium, compact — under Settings › Appearance › Popover, previewed live in the popover while Settings is open
  • Isha's window closes at the first third of the night rather than at Fajr; the check-in, the make-up ledger and the timeline all read the same boundary
  • Every screen of the popover scrolls instead of cropping, not only Streak
  • The Day Complete celebration rains confetti — strips, triangles, stars and diamonds, falling from the top edge
  • Plural notification bodies ("Prayer in 10 minutes", "Sunrise in 20 minutes") resolve the app's language rather than the registered default, and the window banner's countdown units are localized
  • The menu-bar title updates reliably under a fast tick (its subscriber throttles instead of debouncing)
  • Sessions are accounted for: a launch reports how the previous run ended — graceful, crashed or killed — to analytics on both channels, honouring the Diagnostics opt-out; the privacy manifest and App Store privacy details declare Crash Data
  • Debug builds gain a Notification Simulator window that checks authorization, alert style and sound before posting one of each notification the app sends

item.title: Version 4.2.0
item.description:
• A real moon. The night scenes draw tonight's astronomical phase (TinyMoon) instead of a cosine of the Hijri day, tipped by the observer's latitude and hour so the crescent leans at Makkah, smiles at the equator and mirrors in the south; a painted four-face surface sheet replaces the gradient blobs, and the terminator fades along its true ellipse
  • Tonight's phase glyph beside the Hijri date on Home; a Moon Phase card in the Hijri calendar with the illuminated fraction and the days to the next new or full moon, in all five languages
  • The Salawat reminder's default interval is 10 minutes (was 20) on a fresh install
  • About › Email reaches support@abd3lraouf.dev
  • Screens and actions are instrumented (`AppTelemetry`): one `Screen.viewed` event per surface, settings changes by key only, prayer marks by source — honouring the Diagnostics opt-out, with a test that every declared screen is reached from app code
  • Two bugs that made the analytics look empty: the injection-library check matched `ArgumentParserInternal` on the substring `gum` and marked paying customers as instrumented; and every Debug launch overwrote the installed app's session record so no abnormal exit was ever reported — the record is now per bundle path

item.title: Version 4.3.0
item.description:
• The sound channels are audible again. Re-adding a notification identifier that is already sitting in Notification Center is an in-place update — no banner presented, no sound played — and 280 of 282 Salawat deliveries over three days were exactly that, the pre-prayer announcement with them. Every reusable identifier now withdraws its delivered copy before the add, and the reminder is a clock-derived chain with rotating identifiers so consecutive fires are distinct deliveries
  • The Salawat clip is the app's, not the notification's. A `UNNotificationSound` answers to whatever Focus is active, to the alert style and the system alert volume, is capped at 30 s with the default beep as the fallback, and offers no volume control. The request is armed silent and the app plays the clip at fire time — once per fire, never stale after a sleep, deferred while the screen is locked
  • A clip of your own for the Salawat reminder — any audio file, copied into Application Support (not a security-scoped bookmark) and previewed on selection; it overrides Reminder Voice and falls back to the bundled clip if the file goes missing
  • Per-channel volume. The adhan, the announcement and the reminder no longer share one knob: each has its own key, synced between Macs, with its slider under the voice that speaks it. Volume is applied live to the clip already sounding via `UserDefaults.didChangeNotification` — the trim's fade-out is the one ramp a live change leaves alone
  • Prayer Check-In is a window, not a notification. `PrayerCheckInWindowController` + `PrayerCheckInView`: real buttons, a two-step answer with its own painted sky per outcome, Escape/Return, and no dependence on notification permission. Nothing is armed, so the scheduler asks the arithmetic on each tick which fire is behind the clock and presents once per answer — one question per fire, asked on wake if slept through, taken down when the prayer's window closes
  • A "What's New" sheet on the first launch after an update, spanning every release the user crossed, from `Resources/whats_new.json` in all five languages; afterwards from the app menu and Settings ▸ About. `WhatsNewTests` fails the suite when `MARKETING_VERSION` has no entry
  • Seventeen dead switches. "Show Sunnah Prayers" showed nothing, "Track Prayers & Streaks" off still wrote to the log, onboarding's two switches saved without rescheduling, Native Numerals never reached an armed banner, "Animate the Ambient Sky" was read once, and an iCloud settings push landed on disk and nowhere else — plus the widget and Shortcuts rendering in the wrong language, clock, digits and time zone; Hijri day correction never reaching Ramadan; Ambient Display observing one of its three gates; and the application main menu never re-localized
  • The Salawat chain under audit: no arming from the test host, a 60 s back-off on a refused `add`, the scheduler suspended before a quit's daemon wipe, the delivery grace measured from the last passed fire, and no plan holding two fires under one identifier across a DST spring-forward
  • Notification telemetry tells the truth: `in_center` distinguishes `responded` and `not_listed`, and `Prayer.fired` no longer claims `adhan_off` for Sunrise, `announcement_off` for the card-only pre moment or `no_banner` for the silent-by-design at-prayer banner
  • Debug builds gain a Sound Channels submenu (fire a reminder in 10 s or ~2 s, play either clip, withdraw debug fires, copy chain diagnostics), a Prayer Check-In submenu, and two What's New rows including a simulated update
  • CI holds a machine-wide `flock` while the hosted app is under test, so two runs on the same Mac cannot fight over the test host

item.title: Version 4.4.0
item.description:
• The tip sheet is a painted room, not a system alert. A full-bleed rooftop at twilight — a dallah, a cup, a crescent over a lit city — with the title on the picture behind a scrim; the banner's height is derived from the artwork's own ratio so `.aspectRatio(.fill)` cannot crop the crescent off the top. Tier rows became cards with a badge, a caption saying what the tip *does*, and the price in a pill; an earned tier carries a check in its own metal
  • The sheet had no control that closed it. On the App Store build the only ways out were completing a purchase or whatever the window manager did with Escape. It carries the `ProPaywallFooter` shape now — "Restore Donations · Not now" — with Escape wired to the dismissal
  • The tip sheet reads right-to-left in Arabic, Farsi and Urdu. A macOS `.sheet` is hosted outside the presenting view's tree, so the locale, layout direction and script `LanguageManagerView` installs never reached it — and `NSLocalizedString` reads the swapped bundle rather than the environment, so the copy arrived correctly inside a left-to-right layout. The values are applied on the sheet itself, which covers both presenters
  • Windows open on the display you are looking at. `NSWindow.center()` centres on the screen holding the *key* window, and an `LSUIElement` app never owns one — so the What's New sheet and the onboarding canvas opened wherever the last-focused application happened to be. `centerOnActiveScreen()` follows the pointer, the rule `PrayerCheckInWindowController.restingFrame` already used
  • The countdown is legible over a daylight sky. `MeridianHero`'s scrim stack was calibrated on the premise that the app's own skies "are all dark"; `.day` measures 0.87 Rec. 709 luma, so the plate needing the most protection was hard-coded to assume it needed none and the emerald countdown sat at 2.2:1 over sunlit sand. `SceneDef.bodyScrim` is per-scene, solved as the smallest alpha bringing all six accents to 3:1 across both bands — the three dark scenes solve to zero, so the night look does not move
  • A tip tier shows `DonationTier`'s own price rather than an em dash when no StoreKit product has resolved. Both channels charge the same, so there was never anything to withhold
  • The marketing capture set is written down. `marketing/capture-manifest.json` lists every hero, loop and still and the feature each exists to show; `MarketingCoverageTests` pins those names to the four places they must appear and goes red on a `MARKETING_VERSION` bump until a person reads the release's highlights against the list. Between 4.0 and 4.3 the app gained the Check-In window, the What's New sheet, donation tiers and streaming adhan previews and none of them reached a screenshot
  • Four intrusions removed from the capture path, each of which had shipped into the five-language set: the CoreLocation TCC panel across the location picker (guarded at `LocationService` *and* at `UserAnnotation`, which asks CoreLocation directly), notifications armed by an earlier launch landing over the current one, a check-in panel the scheduler raised mid-shot, and "Donations aren't available right now" from an unentitled capture host
  • A full capture is minutes shorter: `launch()`'s flat `sleep(3)` across ~120 launches became a 1.5 s floor, and the settings-route sweep is one launch per language visiting seven routes on a timetable instead of thirty-five launches
  • The birds are gone — `Birds3D`, `BirdSpriteLayer` and the four flight atlases. `SkySpriteLayer` keeps clouds, beams and muzzle FX
  • Telemetry closes three gaps: a throttled `App.foregrounded` beat, so a resident menu-bar app running for days no longer under-counts engagement; an outbox flush on foreground as well as launch; and `active_seconds` on `App.sessionEnded`
  • `fastlane attach_build` and `assert_version_is_editable` — uploading a build does not attach it, and `upload_metadata` will happily rewrite a version that is waiting for review
